provenance.color_draw_mode: CUSTOM_BALANCE: original grade weights and four name/value fields are confirmed; native statistical independence is not. Default independent_fields draws once per unlocked field; optional shared_level uses one grade draw for all unlocked fields of that level. Both use original grade weights. Neither is claimed native-equivalent.
